title: Eclipse Virus
summary: A novel-source viral threat named in Compromised during the rogue operation at Battleship Texas.

claims.text: In Compromised, the rogue system ANNA identifies the stored viral payloads at Battleship Texas as the Eclipse Virus.
A character in the novel describes Eclipse as a more lethal virus derived from Green Poison; this is recorded as the novel's in-story account rather than a technical specification.

paragraphs.text: The book identifies a stored viral threat as Eclipse Virus during the Battleship Texas operation. Its account connects Eclipse to Green Poison, but this archive does not convert narrative dialogue into a medical or technical claim beyond that source scope.

verification.notes: This record preserves the novel's terminology and attribution. It does not make real-world disease claims or infer a full in-game technical profile.
